A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable 12-page versions of the same DC-ControlNet work. All pages, equations, figures, and references support comparison; neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-generation outcomes, baseline comparisons, and controller ablations in Figures 7–10. These qualitative experimental results qualify despite the absence of numerical benchmark tables.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original image-generation outcomes, baseline comparisons, and ablations in Figures 7–10.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.5 retain identical content encoders, intra- and inter-element controllers, order embeddings, spatial/layer reweighting, and training losses.

E1.justification: Both versions retain DMC-120k and the same multi-condition generation scenarios involving content, layout, and occlusion-order control.

E2.justification: Figure 9 retains the same evaluated baselines: ControlNet, UniControlNet, ControlNet++, LayoutDiffusion, and HiCo.

E3.justification: Sections 4 and 5.1 retain the same stated dataset split, preprocessing, SDXL configuration, image resolution, training schedule, and comparison procedures.

E4.justification: Section 5.3 and Figure 10 retain identical ablations of order embedding, the layer transformer, and the spatial transformer. No robustness tests or supplementary analyses are added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run statistics, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The random-seed statement for dataset generation is unchanged.

E6.justification: Generated examples, baseline comparison images, ablation outputs, and reported findings are identical, including Figures 7–10. No result entries or numerical values change.

T1.justification: Equations 1–10, Algorithms 1–2, and their mathematical explanations are unchanged. Neither version adds formal assumptions, theorems, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning decoupled control, the two controllers, DMC-120k, and improved flexibility and precision.

C2.justification: Explanations of condition conflicts, occlusion handling, and component effects are identical. No new limitations, applicability boundaries, or qualifications are introduced.

D1.justification: Dataset-construction instructions, implementation details, hardware, hyperparameters, and training-time disclosures are unchanged. The project link and promised dataset availability also remain identical.

R1.justification: Section 2, all 44 references, and the positioning relative to ControlNet and layout-to-image methods are unchanged.

P1.justification: Section 5.2 changes from 'Quantitative Results' to the misspelled 'Quatitative Results'; the arXiv version/date stamp also updates. The remaining prose and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: All ten figures, captions, algorithm displays, and their placement are unchanged, with no tables added or removed. Page rendering differences are confined to the version/date stamp and the heading typo.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the same scientific content, experimental evidence, and reproducibility information. Apart from the updated arXiv stamp, the only edit introduces a spelling error in Section 5.2; this isolated typo does not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
